messages.author: 2a13147d4f12d038
messages.subject: ggsave keep and drop parameters
parts:
The help entry for ggsave mentions the optional keep and drop
parameters:

dpi=300, keep = plot$options$keep, drop = plot$options$drop, ...)

What is an example of what might be specified for keep or drop? I
don't seem to understand the syntax. I tried some things like

drop=p$options$labels$x

but that gave an error.

Thanks in advance for any tips
Alex

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: ggsave keep and drop parameters
parts:
Alex, 

I've never used these options, but I'm wondering if instead of p$options... it actually needs to be plot$options... because one of the other calls in ggsave() is plot= and the default is last_plot() I believe.  I tried that and got an error as well. 


qplot(1:10, 1:10)
ggsave("1.png", drop=plot$options$labels$x)



saving 7.43" x 7.67" image
Error in plot$options : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable



str(last_plot())



List of 8
 <SNIP>
 $ options    :List of 1
  ..$ labels:List of 2
  .. ..$ x: chr "1:10"
  .. ..$ y: chr "1:10"
 <SNIP>
 $ plot_env   :<environment: R_GlobalEnv> 
 - attr(*, "class")= chr "ggplot"





I would think that it should do something, but obviously we're missing something or the function has been deprecated and the help wasn't updated. Also, if you don't want the axis labels, wouldn't it be just as easy to set them to theme_blank() with +opts()?






Brandon

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: ggsave keep and drop parameters
parts:
They're not very well documented because they're experimental. But
basically both keep and drop should be a character vector containing
any or all of the following strings: title, xlabel, ylabel, panels,
legend_box.

Hadley
